title: MSV + Anglesey Tracks
intro:
[h1]MSV + Anglesey Tracks[/h1]
The seven MotorSport Vision circuits plus Anglesey Circuit (Trac Mon), rebuilt from open map and LIDAR data: {circuits} circuits, {layouts} layouts. Each circuit has its current official layouts with the real racing direction and start/finish lines, real elevation and camber, measured track widths, a 24-car grid, AI and the in-race minimap.
lapNote: Lap lengths are as built in the game.
usage: Subscribe, then enable [b]MSV + Anglesey Tracks[/b] in the Mods menu and restart the game. Each layout is an event, e.g. "Brands Hatch Indy".
Online: the server and every player need the mod enabled (server: copy the mod folder into the server's mods folder and add that folder's name to mods= in server_config.cfg).
Don't enable it together with separate single-circuit versions of these tracks: the same track in two mods clashes.
